load_and_preprocess_data: load and preprocess computational and experimental electrocatalysis data with XRD matching and XRF composition mapping
get_production_rate: convert faradaic efficiency and current density to a production rate in mol per cm squared per second
get_distance_between_formulas: compute the euclidean distance between two chemical composition formulas like Pt-0.5-Pd-0.5
get_constant_V: interpolate experimental CO2R data to a fixed applied potential using log-linear interpolation
add_cv_categories: add leave-one-out and leave-one-composition-out cross-validation columns to a dataframe for ML training
